reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing getScheduledAmount helper that every consumer already calls, keeping getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the range and approximate branches each shrink to one expression.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the planned-amount decision already lives.

scope.why: Only the helper and its tests change.

maintainability.why: Simple, commented Math.min / subtract-threshold logic in one place that all forecast, template and API paths share.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All amount consumers keep going through getScheduledAmount.
